summary: Proposes a benchmark that isolates the effect of the agent harness (context, tools, memory, validation) from the underlying model on realistic multi-step workflows. Claims that harness quality can dominate raw model capability on task success. Frames harness engineering as a measurable, first-class variable.
title: Harness-Bench: Measuring Harness Effects across Models in Realistic Agent Workflows
why: If harness effects are measurable and large, runtime substrate design is a primary lever, not an afterthought.
